name: Athens Farmers Market
tagline: The Gathering Farms — Fruit in Athens, TX
description: Athens Farmers Market is a farmers market in 212 N Palestine Athens, TX, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
